prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow Chick</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background: #f2f2f2; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 244px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

/* ---------- renderer / scene / camera ---------- */
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NeutralToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf2f2f2);

const ref = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 244 / 240, 0.1, 100);
ref.position.set(0, 2.05, 6.45);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.62, 0);

/* ---------- lights (soft studio, reads from all sides) ---------- */
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xd8cfc0, 0.85));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2e0, 1.7);
key.position.set(2.5, 4.5, 4.0);
scene.add(key);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe8f0ff, 0.55);
fill.position.set(-3.5, 1.5, 2.5);
scene.add(fill);
const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
rim.position.set(0, 3.5, -4.5);
scene.add(rim);

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function ss(a, b, x) {
  const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a)));
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}
function radialTexture(inner, outer) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 64;
  const g = c.getContext('2d');
  const grad = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 2, 32, 32, 32);
  grad.addColorStop(0, inner);
  grad.addColorStop(1, outer);
  g.fillStyle = grad;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return tex;
}

/* ---------- environment ---------- */
const env = new THREE.Group();
env.name = 'environment';
scene.add(env);

// backdrop with soft vignette
const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40, 24),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: radialTexture('#ffffff', '#e9e9e9') })
);
backdrop.name = 'backdrop';
backdrop.position.set(0, 6, -7);
env.add(backdrop);

// floor
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(60, 60),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf5f5f5, roughness: 1 })
);
floor.name = 'floor';
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
env.add(floor);

// soft contact shadow
const shadow = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.CircleGeometry(1.9, 40),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    map: radialTexture('rgba(70,58,45,0.34)', 'rgba(70,58,45,0)'),
    transparent: true, depthWrite: false
  })
);
shadow.name = 'contact-shadow';
shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
shadow.position.y = 0.01;
shadow.scale.set(1, 0.85, 1);
env.add(shadow);

/* ---------- materials ---------- */
const YELLOW = new THREE.Color(0xffcf3f);
const CREAM  = new THREE.Color(0xfff6e2);
const TOPLIT = new THREE.Color(0xffe27a);
const BLUSH  = new THREE.Color(0xffab5e);

const bodyMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0 });
const yellowMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffcf3f, roughness: 0.85 });
const brownMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6e4526, roughness: 0.7 });
const beakMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff9a3c, roughness: 0.6 });
const lowerBeakMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf2a988, roughness: 0.6 });
const mouthMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8a4a20, roughness: 0.8 });
const eyeMat   = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x141414, roughness: 0.3 });
const glintMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff });

/* ---------- character ---------- */
const chick = new THREE.Group();
chick.name = 'character-chick';
scene.add(chick);

/* body: one smooth pear/blob lathe with painted cream belly */
const ctrl = [
  [0.00, 0.00], [0.55, 0.03], [0.92, 0.14], [1.14, 0.38], [1.24, 0.70],
  [1.24, 1.00], [1.14, 1.30], [0.98, 1.60], [0.78, 1.90], [0.58, 2.12],
  [0.52, 2.28], [0.56, 2.48], [0.62, 2.68], [0.58, 2.88], [0.46, 3.02],
  [0.28, 3.12], [0.00, 3.18]
];
const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(ctrl.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p[0], p[1], 0)), false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
const profile = curve.getPoints(120).map(v => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, v.x), v.y));
const bodyGeo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(profile, 72);

{
  const pos = bodyGeo.attributes.position;
  const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
  const c = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
    c.copy(YELLOW);
    // cream belly oval on the front
    const d = (x / 0.98) ** 2 + ((y - 1.02) / 1.12) ** 2;
    const belly = ss(1.05, 0.78, d) * ss(0.12, 0.5, z);
    c.lerp(CREAM, belly);
    // lighter crown
    c.lerp(TOPLIT, 0.3 * ss(2.75, 3.15, y));
    // faint warm cheeks
    for (const sx of [-0.3, 0.3]) {
      const db = Math.sqrt((x - sx) ** 2 + (y - 2.72) ** 2);
      c.lerp(BLUSH, 0.4 * ss(0.15, 0.05, db) * ss(0.35, 0.55, z));
    }
    colors[i * 3] = c.r; colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
  }
  bodyGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
}
const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, bodyMat);
body.name = 'body';
chick.add(body);

/* face group (head region of the blob) */
const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 2.66, 0);
chick.add(head);

function makeEye(side) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = side < 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right';
  const ball = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.055, 20, 16), eyeMat);
  ball.name = 'eyeball';
  g.add(ball);
  const glint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.013, 8, 8), glintMat);
  glint.name = 'glint';
  glint.position.set(-0.016, 0.02, 0.045);
  g.add(glint);
  g.position.set(side * 0.26, 0.27, 0.45);
  return g;
}
head.add(makeEye(-1));
head.add(makeEye(1));

/* mouth / beak */
const mouth = new THREE.Group();
mouth.name = 'mouth';
mouth.position.set(0, 0.0, 0);
mouth.rotation.x = 0.1;
head.add(mouth);

const upperBeak = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16), beakMat);
upperBeak.name = 'beak-upper';
upperBeak.scale.set(0.20, 0.085, 0.14);
upperBeak.position.set(0, 0.045, 0.60);
mouth.add(upperBeak);

const mouthSlit = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 12), mouthMat);
mouthSlit.name = 'mouth-inner';
mouthSlit.scale.set(0.16, 0.028, 0.10);
mouthSlit.position.set(0, -0.005, 0.60);
mouth.add(mouthSlit);

const lowerBeak = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16), lowerBeakMat);
lowerBeak.name = 'beak-lower';
lowerBeak.scale.set(0.15, 0.06, 0.11);
lowerBeak.position.set(0, -0.05, 0.575);
mouth.add(lowerBeak);

/* wing tips: rounded brown "kiss" shape */
const tipCtrl = [[0, 0], [0.20, 0.02], [0.27, 0.12], [0.24, 0.28], [0.15, 0.42], [0.05, 0.52], [0, 0.56]];
const tipCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(tipCtrl.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p[0], p[1], 0)), false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
const tipProfile = tipCurve.getPoints(40).map(v => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, v.x), v.y));
const tipGeo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(tipProfile, 32);

function makeArm(side) {
  const left = side < 0;
  const arm = new THREE.Group();
  arm.name = left ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  arm.position.set(side * (left ? 0.62 : 0.66), left ? 1.42 : 1.62, left ? 0.55 : 0.45);
  arm.rotation.z = left ? 0.18 : -1.0;
  arm.rotation.x = left ? -0.25 : -0.2;

  const upper = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.165, left ? 0.22 : 0.36, 8, 16), yellowMat);
  upper.name = 'upper-arm';
  upper.position.set(0, left ? 0.16 : 0.26, 0);
  arm.add(upper);

  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = left ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right';
  hand.position.set(0, left ? 0.34 : 0.52, 0);
  hand.rotation.z = left ? 0.12 : 0.5;
  hand.rotation.x = 0.15;
  const tip = new THREE.Mesh(tipGeo, brownMat);
  tip.name = 'wing-tip';
  tip.scale.set(1, 1, 0.85);
  hand.add(tip);
  arm.add(hand);
  return arm;
}
chick.add(makeArm(-1));
chick.add(makeArm(1));

/* small tail bump at the back (hidden from the reference view) */
const tail = new THREE.Group();
tail.name = 'tail';
tail.position.set(0, 0.85, -1.02);
tail.rotation.x = -1.25;
const tailMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.18, 0.4, 20), yellowMat);
tailMesh.name = 'tail-feathers';
tailMesh.position.y = 0.15;
tail.add(tailMesh);
chick.add(tail);

/* ---------- static pose + render ---------- */
function render(t) {
  // static scene: pose is fixed, deterministic for any t
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref },
  characters: [chick],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
